name: @w6w-apps/google-meet
description: Create and manage Google Meet spaces, and read conference records, participants, recordings and transcripts.

w6w.longDescription:
Google Meet is the video-conferencing product behind meet.google.com, and its REST API is organized around two things: the space, a durable room that always has the same join link, and the conference record, a single instance of a call held in that space.

This app lets a workflow create a space (and tune who can join, how, and what artifacts Meet generates), read or patch its settings, and end a live conference in it. It also reads the full recording of what happened: the conference records for a space, who attended, when each person joined and left, and any recordings and transcripts Meet produced — down to the individual transcript entries.

Space co-hosts can be listed and read here, but not yet changed; and the newer smartNotes resource is deliberately left out (see the README).

A fit for standing up a recurring meeting room, auditing who actually attended a call, or pulling a transcript into another system once a recording lands in Drive.
